lead_headline: Ciao Babe debuts Italian street food at Avanti today, while Blazing Bird expands to East Colfax and 1up Arcade Bar closes LoDo after 15 years

restaurant.blurb: 3 leads today: Ciao Babe (Highland Italian at Avanti), Blazing Bird East Colfax (8th Colorado hot chicken spot), Dairy Queen Littleton (Fort Logan closure). Week's 242 active leads: 129 openings, 113 closures.

liquor.blurb: Eleventh straight zero-application day extends statewide freeze to 28 days—7-day total remains locked at 369 licenses, all June 14 timestamps from backlog dump. No new filings, status changes, or removals since mid-month. June's count frozen at 369 against 800+ monthly norm. System shutdown now longest in dataset, signaling infrastructure crisis beyond routine delays.

reputation.blurb: +5 mentions yesterday hold steady at mid-week pace, keeping 7-day total at 47 across 12 sources—down 22% from prior week's 60. Facebook leads with 17 citations (36% share), Denver Post follows with 10, Hoodline and mystery domain tied at 4 each, Reddit added 3. Week featured 1up closure coverage and Yoshi Cocktail Bar planning stories. Monthly count hits 203 with week remaining. Google News RSS captured 44 of 47 discoveries (94%).

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) marks sixth consecutive zero day, holding MTD at +25 (+1.0/day) and 90-day net at +131. Extended June 19-24 freeze (just +1 net across six days) follows strong June 11-18 run that delivered +16 net. Six-day dormancy unusual but MTD pace still tracks near YTD baseline (+1.2/day) as month closes.
